items.content:
In this episode of Discover La Jolla, I had the privilege of speaking with Bill Kellogg, President of the La Jolla Beach & Tennis Club. Bill shares the remarkable history of La Jolla Shores and the Kellogg family's long-standing role in shaping and preserving this iconic coastal community.

As we discuss the heritage and evolution of La Jolla, we also highlight the importance of protecting the La Jolla Cove, part of the Matlahuayl State Marine Reserve, also known as the San Diego La Jolla Underwater Park. This year’s 4th of July celebration will feature the drone show, a creative and thoughtful way to honor the area’s natural beauty while bringing the community together for something truly special. I’m currently working to raise funds to help continue this tradition and ensure we preserve what makes this place so unique.

Listen to the full episode here: https://lnkd.in/gWP5ewBd

To learn more or contribute to the preservation effort, visit: ljsteam.org
